intent: revise industrial starting point into concept sketch master
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: MASTER HAND-DRAWN CONCEPT SHEET for one original human space-ark carrier GUIHANG. Image 1 is the existing rough design to revise, not a finished ship.
User direction: grounded Mobile Suit Gundam-style naval mechanical design, restrained and handsome, no fantasy monument. FIRST CONCEPT SKETCHES, not Blender renders or final manufacturing drawings.
Revise these specific design weaknesses in the reference:
1. Keep its heavy enclosed long body, short faceted bow, warm-white / slate-blue / graphite / sparse brick-red palette. Replace the monotonous cargo-box profile with THREE clear connected masses: thick protected forward shoulder, slightly recessed midship service waist, broad aft engineering shoulders. These are substantial hull transitions, not wings or added spikes.
2. Make the command bridge a LOW compact semi-recessed armored island in the aft third. Remove the tall forest of naval antenna masts and the giant row of bridge windows. The ship is kilometer-class; fine grouped inhabited window lights must be tiny. Keep one short sensor mast.
3. On the visible PORT side of the midship service waist, clearly show TWO distinct rectangular recessed mouths side by side along the hull length, separated by a thick structural pier. The FORWARD mouth is LAUNCH; the AFT mouth is RECOVERY, a little wider. Actual dark tunnel depth, outer doors, inner framing and guides visible in BOTH mouths. These are side-facing, safely ahead of the stern thrusters. A tiny original humanoid mobile-frame in the launch cradle and a tiny four-arm industrial frame near the recovery mouth identify the carrier's role. No generic shuttle as the only payload.
4. The stern has SIX main engine apertures TOTAL, arranged as TWO columns of THREE, clearly built into sturdy structural modules. Fore-aft direction obvious. From the hero view only the near bank and part of the far bank need be visible. Small attitude thrusters and short cooling vanes; not giant fins.
5. Preserve a broad quiet sealed forebody for sleeping community, a thin grouped habitation band above the waist, dense service details only around the two ports, and separately colored aft machinery. A few replaced panels and dark sealed sectors imply a long life; no luxurious terraces or exposed parks.
Layout 1536x1024 landscape, tasteful HAND-DRAWN DESIGN SKETCH presentation on off-white paper. Top 70 percent: one complete revised mother ship in front-port three-quarter view, enough side visible to read both ports, generous margins. Bottom left 25 percent: small strict SIDE silhouette sketch of the SAME ship, showing the low bridge and three mass transitions. Bottom right 25 percent: enlarged mechanical detail of the SAME paired side ports with central divider, 20-meter-class mecha dwarfed by the doorway, thick opening rim and inner rail/capture frame. Labels ONLY "GUIHANG / CARRIER STUDY", "LAUNCH", "RECOVERY" in small restrained drafting typography. No fake handwritten paragraphs, no dimensions, no second ship alternative.
Style: professional original anime-mecha designer's exploratory pen/pencil and marker sheet, clean purposeful contour lines with subtle construction lines, restrained color blocking, crisp shaded angular surfaces, legible dark mechanical recesses. Beauty through proportions and controlled detail. NOT a photograph, CGI product render, stone building, rounded seed, crown, scythe, luxury liner or toy. Do not copy Archangel's split prow, any Gundam logo or any existing franchise ship. No gun batteries, space background, planets or bright engine bloom. This is a concept mother sheet, not a validated technical projection.
